summary: Nevada AG Aaron Ford joined 13 other state AGs in a statement denouncing Hamas rocket strikes and kidnappings, saying they are 'grieving the lives lost in Israel and Gaza.'

summary: Nevada AG Aaron Ford announced his office would send tactical gear to the IDF and stated he would 'do everything in my power to ensure that the Jewish community feels safe in Nevada.'
